features.min_evidence_for_none: N/A - this key never uses NONE (settlement_type is always exactly one of the enum values or UNKNOWN).
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official population/administrative classification (e.g. city/comune/municipality charter) or a clearly reliable general encyclopedia entry describing built character.
features.notes: Repeatable: exactly one row per destination must be marked PRIMARY in `notes`; additional legitimate characteristics may be added as SECONDARY rows rather than forcing a single label.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Clear evidence the destination is not suburban in form (e.g. historic urban core or rural/resort character confirmed).
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official municipal description or reliable encyclopedia characterization of built form.
features.notes: availability_level expresses strength of suburban character; feature_value stays NOT_APPLICABLE.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Evidence the local economy/character is not resort/tourism-oriented.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official tourism-board or municipal economic description.
features.notes: availability_level expresses strength; STRONG = tourism/resort identity is a defining part of local life.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Evidence retirees are not a notable share of residents/visitors.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official/government recognition (e.g. named a top retirement destination) or clear demographic evidence.
features.notes: availability_level expresses strength.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No significant college/university presence.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Confirmed major university enrollment relative to city population from an encyclopedia or official source.
features.notes: availability_level expresses strength.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No notable master-planned/gated development found in the destination's residential fabric.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named, verifiable master-planned or gated development(s) confirmed by an official or reliable source.
features.notes: availability_level expresses strength/prevalence, not a single project's existence.

features.min_evidence_for_none: N/A - use UNKNOWN, not NONE, when evidence is insufficient.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Multiple consistent descriptive sources (official + reputable secondary) characterizing daily pace/atmosphere.
features.notes: Qualitative descriptor, not a strength scale; NONE is never a valid value for this key.

features.min_evidence_for_none: N/A - use UNKNOWN, not NONE.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official tourism-board seasonal visitor data or clearly documented peak-season crowding/pricing pattern.
features.notes: Distinct from EVENTS_SEASONALITY (event-level); this is a whole-destination crowding/atmosphere signal.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Destination confirmed landlocked with no coastal frontage.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official geographic description or encyclopedia confirming direct coastal frontage.

features.min_evidence_for_none: N/A - always mirrored, never independently set to NONE.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: N/A - mirrors DESTINATIONS.beach_access verbatim (HIGH confidence by construction).
features.notes: feature_value MUST mirror the existing authoritative DESTINATIONS.beach_access field verbatim, never independently re-researched or contradicted. matching_enabled=NO because the real hard-gate/profile-matching field is DESTINATIONS.beach_access itself; this row exists for display/narrative parity only.

features.min_evidence_for_none: N/A - always mirrored, never independently set to NONE.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: N/A - mirrors DESTINATIONS.mountain_or_ski_access verbatim (HIGH confidence by construction).
features.notes: feature_value MUST mirror the existing authoritative DESTINATIONS.mountain_or_ski_access field verbatim. matching_enabled=NO for the same reason as beach_access.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No named lake within a reasonable regional radius found in any reliable source.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official/park-authority source naming a specific lake and its distance.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No named river within a reasonable regional radius found in any reliable source.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official/geographic source naming the specific river and confirming access.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Confirmed absence of forest/woodland within a reasonable regional radius.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named national/regional park or forest confirmed by an official source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Confirmed non-arid Koppen climate classification or equivalent.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official climatological classification (e.g. Koppen) from a government meteorological source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Destination confirmed to have no meaningful rural/agricultural hinterland nearby.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official geographic/land-use description confirming surrounding rural character.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Climate/elevation evidence makes seasonal snow at or near the destination implausible (e.g. tropical climate at low elevation).
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official climate-normal data showing measurable snowfall, or a named, currently-operating snow area.

features.min_evidence_for_none: A specific search for a marina/small-craft harbor found only commercial/ferry port infrastructure with no leisure-boat facilities.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official marina/port-authority source naming the facility and confirming leisure-boat services (slips, fuel, moorings).
features.notes: Must not be inferred from beach_access alone; a commercial ferry/cargo port is not a marina.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No public boat ramp/launch identified in any reliable local or official source.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named public boat ramp confirmed by a municipal/parks source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Confirmed marina/harbor exists but offers no slips/moorings, or no marina exists at all.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Marina operator source listing slip/mooring capacity or rates.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No powerboat rental/tour/launch operator identified and no boating infrastructure found.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named operator or public launch confirmed by an official/reputable source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No sailing club/operator identified and no evidence of sailing activity.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named sailing club/operator with current, verifiable services.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No fishing access point (pier, charter, known local fishing area) identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named fishing pier/charter operator or official fisheries-access source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No kayak rental/put-in point identified and no evidence of the activity.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named outfitter or official park/reserve source confirming a kayaking route.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No paddleboard rental/operator identified and no evidence of the activity.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named outfitter confirmed by an official/reputable source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Named swim spots explicitly found unsuitable/closed (e.g. water-quality or safety notice) with no alternative nearby.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official beach/water-quality authority confirming safe designated swimming.
features.notes: Distinct from beach_access - a destination can have beach access without confirmed safe/practical swimming (e.g. surf, currents, water quality).

features.min_evidence_for_none: No surf break/school identified and coastal conditions make surf unlikely.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named surf break/school confirmed by a reputable surf-specific or official source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No dive/snorkel site or operator identified and reef/visibility conditions are not documented.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named, independently recognized dive site (e.g. marine-protected area, ranked dive-site list) or certified dive operator.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No golf course identified within a reasonable regional radius.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named, operating golf course confirmed by an official/course-operator source (existing PLACES entries qualify).
features.notes: Where a PLACES row with category_key='golf' already exists for the destination, reuse it directly rather than re-researching.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No pickleball court/club identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named public/club courts confirmed by a municipal parks & recreation or club source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No tennis court/club identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named public/club courts confirmed by a municipal or club source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Climate/elevation makes any ski operation implausible, or all previously known ski areas are confirmed closed.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named, currently operating ski area confirmed by its own official source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No hiking trail/trailhead identified within a reasonable regional radius.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named trail confirmed by an official park/trail-authority source (existing PLACES trail rows qualify).

features.min_evidence_for_none: No walking/multi-use trail identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named, mapped trail confirmed by a municipal/park source.
features.notes: Distinct from hiking_access, which implies more rugged/natural terrain; trail_access covers everyday walking/biking corridors.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No road-cycling infrastructure or documented route identified, and road conditions are documented as unsafe/impractical.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named cycling route/lane confirmed by a municipal or cycling-organization source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No mountain-bike trail/park identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named mountain-bike trail system confirmed by an official/trail-authority source.

features.min_evidence_for_none: General lawful recreational hunting access is confirmed unavailable or heavily restricted regionally.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Official wildlife/hunting-authority source confirming general lawful recreational access exists regionally.
features.notes: Record only general lawful recreational access and regional proximity - never personalized licensing, season, or weapons-law advice.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No public park/open space identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named, existing PLACES park row(s) or an official municipal parks source.
features.notes: Where PLACES already has park rows for the destination, reuse them directly.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No arts/culture venue or activity identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Multiple named, verifiable venues/institutions (existing PLACES museum/theater/gallery rows qualify).
features.notes: No new external research this phase - derive only from existing PLACES/neighborhood/narrative content per the approved scope.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No museum/gallery identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Existing PLACES museum rows or an official cultural-institution source.
features.notes: Derive from existing PLACES category_key='museum' rows.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No live-music venue identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Existing PLACES live_music rows or a named, currently operating venue.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No recurring festival/event identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Named, recurring, officially documented festival(s).

features.min_evidence_for_none: No meaningful dining options identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Existing PLACES restaurant rows in meaningful quantity/variety.
features.notes: Derive from existing PLACES restaurant/dining counts.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No cafe/coffee shop identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Existing PLACES coffee_shop rows.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No nightlife venue identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Existing PLACES nightlife rows or multiple named venues.

features.min_evidence_for_none: No farmers/traditional market identified.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Existing PLACES farmers_market/market rows or an official market schedule.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Documented friction/isolation for newcomers with no offsetting community infrastructure.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Existing DAILY_LIFE_PRACTICALITY.newcomer_friction narrative plus corroborating community/expat-organization evidence.
features.notes: Reuse existing DAILY_LIFE_PRACTICALITY/COMMUNITY_SOCIAL narrative first.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Documented lack of family-oriented infrastructure (schools, childcare, family activities).
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Existing FAMILY_EDUCATION sheet content.
features.notes: Reuse existing FAMILY_EDUCATION sheet content first.

features.min_evidence_for_none: Documented lack of pet-friendly infrastructure/rentals.
features.min_evidence_for_high_confidence: Existing PETS sheet content.
features.notes: Reuse existing PETS sheet content first.
